milestones.outcome: Expensive Qt and composed correctness qualification preserves every case occurrence while audited commands can share bounded native capacity.
exit_criteria: The selected workbench command/case/scale/platform/configuration inventory accounts for all intended occurrences and rejects missing, duplicate and unknown selections.
The candidate preserves unique behavior, ordered lifecycle groups, fresh ownership, every assertion/workload/deadline and timing exclusivity, with meaningful native matched before/after evidence.
Focused causal controls, current-source/documentation gates, explicit commits, safe integration and a quiescent durable handoff are complete.
milestones.boundary: Only source-audited scheduling and proven equivalent execution consolidation; no conditional evidence reuse, product behavior change, new release or publication.

milestones.outcome: Required fresh and reusable qualification is selected from explicit complete inputs, and redundant compilation is removed only where every assertion has an equivalent owning image.
exit_criteria: Input closure and fail-closed selection retain actual source, tooling, native, performance, security and legal obligations; invalid or unknown evidence requests fresh execution.
All eight composition methods have an assertion-to-build/image matrix before any duplicate build is removed, and configuration-specific assertions remain active.
Trigger mutations, identity invalidation, failed/stale/missing receipts and interrupted execution are verified and all concrete unresolved policy choices remain unready.
milestones.boundary: No automatic waiver of unique long-duration, native, security, performance or material claims; source-scoped prior evidence is visibly distinct from fresh qualification.

milestones.outcome: The stabilized route has an honest request-to-result phase ledger and a measured producer rehearsal that exposes the remaining gap to thirty minutes.
exit_criteria: One durable ledger binds source/configuration/tools, cache condition, lease, child exit and all elapsed preparation/build/qualification/artifact/review/transfer phases.
A stabilized native portfolio and authorized mechanical producer rehearsal retains failures, skips, deferred claims and previous evidence with exact scope.
Measured wall and work, uncertainty, remaining human/security/native obligations and the exact gap to the thirty-minute goal are recorded; publication is absent without separate authorization.
milestones.boundary: No version bump, signing, publishing or destructive asset changes; existing published v0.3.1 artifacts and frozen producers stay immutable.
